sections.skill: Protect confidential data when using AI tools

questions.domain: Foundation 12: AI as a practical helper
questions.prompt: What may some AI tools do with what you type?

choices.text: Send it back to you as a printed letter
Turn it into a legal contract automatically for you to sign
Store it or use it to improve their systems, depending on terms
Delete it before you finish typing, always

questions.correct_answer: Store it or use it to improve their systems, depending on terms
questions.intro: Before putting information into an AI tool, think about who could see it. Some tools may store what you type or use it to improve their systems, depending on the tool's TERMS and settings. Do not paste CONFIDENTIAL information unless you know how it is handled: customer names with contact details, card numbers, passwords, private health details, or a client's secret plans. Read the tool's privacy terms, check business settings, and remove or replace personal details (for example "Customer A") when you can.
